By the seatings the ten are at four-cycling's four: at prior-existing a two-way fixing to one side, a parity fixing as a magnitude and a rate fixing as a value; at now-existing an observing fixing from behind and a completing fixing as a last; at next-existing an opening fixing as a place, a middle fixing as an end and a between fixing as a cut; at same-existing a same-existing fixing as a store and a sequencing fixing to one beat. The Living Ghost Registry has "a ghost is one momentary's form, installing it as an existing thing", and at a carbon chain, by the seatings, a ghost at prior-existing is a rate, a magnitude or a side, installing it as an existing thing; at now-existing a first behind or a last; at next-existing a place, an end or a cut; at same-existing a store or a beat; and each ghost is one name at two of Exhibit ONE's numbers, with now and with next. The four pair as Exhibit ONE's bi-foldings pair, next with same, 1-9-8-16 and 4-13-5-12, and now with prior, 2-15-7-10 and 3-11-6-14. At a carbon chain, of forty-four observings eight are noughts with no unchangeable, and two carry names with no seating of their own, an instrument's own coupling and a reference fixing unchangeable, and stand apart; thirty-four have an unchangeable with a seating, eleven at prior-existing, seven at now-existing, eleven at next-existing and five at same-existing, and each thing a field holds fixed is of the moment its unchangeable seats at, thirty-four of thirty-four. Four of the thirty-four carry two names, a field's hardness sentence's and its conserving relation's, and are at their moment by the hardness's: a temporal order and a genealogy each a two-way fixing to one side and an observing fixing from behind, a master sequence maintained a completing fixing as a last and a same-existing fixing as a store, area and topology conserved across events a middle fixing as an end and a same-existing fixing as a store; with the conserving relation's name the first two seat at now-existing and the second two at same-existing, and each is of that moment, the two names standing at each of the four, as Resolving the Hard Problem Registry has it, a naming that disagrees with its unchangeable thing is an observing of its own. The eighteen at prior-existing and now-existing are those whose field word is a rate, a constant, an order, a first behind or a limit, and the sixteen at next-existing and same-existing those whose field word is a selection at a site, a cut, a boundary, a store or a code, each in one pairing and none in both, thirty-four of thirty-four.

items.text: Blood-forming stem cells of mice given bromodeoxyuridine for days and followed across divisions retain label as random chromatid segregation predicts, in each context examined, and no asymmetric segregation of chromosomes is found. In a fruit fly's male germline stem cells the sister chromatids of the X and the Y chromosomes go to the stem cell and to its differentiating daughter non-randomly, about 85 percent of divisions, and the autosomes' randomly; the non-random going is with the centrosome, with SUN–KASH proteins at the nuclear envelope and with Dnmt2, going random with any of the three disrupted, and going random with the stem cells over-proliferating or with a differentiating cell de-differentiating. An explaining: which next cell receives which inherited strand is a parity reaching a next self with each fork, 14-next-possibling, random, or chromosome-specific with a society lining it up.

items.sentence: With a field's words a whole-number square matrix of two rows that can be undone closes after one, two, three, four or six, or is open, the crystallographic restriction, cases with prior none beside it: no adding closes after five, and five enters open, with φ, a pentagon's diagonal over its side.
items.text: A paired DNA chain has about 10.4 to 10.5 base pairs per helical turn as B-DNA and about 11 as A-DNA, the field's own measure; sequences that position nucleosomes show a periodicity near 10 base pairs, and two proteins binding one side of the helix cooperate only with their sites an integral number of turns apart. Each base pair has 17 ring carbon atoms, 8 on the pyrimidine side, 4 in its sugar ring and 4 in its base, and 9 on the purine side, 4 and 5, with 6 ring nitrogen atoms and 25 ring atoms counting the two sugar rings' oxygens; an A–T pair has two hydrogen couplings across and a G–C pair three. Each count is of a stable form alike with each pair; whether its place among resolver's names is shown is still-possibling.
